blocker: No workflow run or status was observable for the inspected commit through the available GitHub status and commit-run surfaces; therefore jobs, logs, receipts, and artifacts could not be inspected.
release_condition: A workflow run for main becomes observable with a run_id, after which jobs, logs, security-profile receipt, security-gate receipt, pipeline receipt, action provenance, dependency-review result when applicable, and artifact are inspected and a successor reconciliation receipt is committed.
next_action: Repository-native CI executes the existing workflow on a qualifying push, pull request, or workflow_dispatch; the next validation lane records the resulting run evidence.
collision_boundary: Do not create a second validation workflow or claim pass/fail without run, job, log, and artifact evidence.
archive_effect: This receipt durably preserves the unresolved validation state and removes the need to retain chat history solely for CI observation.
